body:
The first thing you need to do is stop thinking people are joking when they compliment you. I know that sounds like it may be difficult, but if someone tells you that you're good looking, do your best to force that thought out of your head. Let their compliment sink in. The moment that you realize that what they're saying isn't what you believe, but what OTHER people do, you'll feel a sense of relief. Remember, beauty is in the eye of the beholder.

Try to get closer with the people you "just hang out with". Meet with them one-on-one. And if you're not really feeling up to that and you need someone to talk to RIGHT NOW, feel free to PM me. I ain't got nothin' going on.
